triggers.detailsText: The order position for Q3 and Q4 looks robust, and we expect to end the year exactly as per the guidance that we had given at the start of the year, which was around 15% volume growth and a similar EBITDA growth as well. But as far as we are concerned, as I was telling that our quarter 3, quarter 4 order book looks robust, and we are well on track to get that 15% volume growth for the year. But as far as our proportions are concerned, it is very much same as what we have seen in the last 2, 3 quarters, largely also because by this time last year, second quarter onwards, the full Vietnam FD capacity was in play.
filingKeyFacts: The order position for Q3 and Q4 looks robust, and we expect to end the year exactly as per the guidance that we had given at the start of the year, which was around 15% volume growth and a similar EBITDA growth as well.

In FY26, the Company reported total income of ₹15,625 mn with an EBITDA margin of ~14.2%.
